name: Miho (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Miho village emblem in white: an outlined trefoil-like loop of three interlocking curves.
history: Municipal flag of Miho, a village in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 1971.

features.role: Miho village emblem — an outlined trefoil-like loop of three interlocking curves
